title: Battle of Forinthry
start: Talk to the Raptor in Fort Forinthry.

recommended.t: 115 Combat, it is recommended that you have combat stats at around level 80.
Food (Sharks or a higher tier of food is recommended)
Salve amulet or its enchanted variant, the salve amulet (e)
Yew logs or better for a bonfire boost

rewards.t: Access to the Zemouregal & Vorkath boss encounter via a commemorative statue in the town hall.

steps.t: Talk to the Raptor in Fort Forinthry. [Chat: 1 Talk about 'Battle of Forinthry'. › Accept › 1 Yes, I am ready.]
Watch the cutscene.
Begin Encounter with Fort Forinthry Gate.
Run north to the camp with an undead giant.
Kill the undead giant. The other enemies are optional.
Disrupt the place of power.
Head west.
Kill the undead giant. The other enemies are optional.
Disrupt the place of power.
Head south.
Kill the undead giant. The other enemies are optional.
Disrupt the place of power.
Defeat the Zemouregal & Vorkath encounter.

sub.t: First use of extra action Ballista after Vorkath lands.
Dive, Surge, or Escape during Vorkath's AoE (10x10 area).
Second use of extra action Ballista when the Raptor mentions "Ready the Balista"
Use Balista as often as possible after this.
Target Zemouregal only after killing Vorkath.

steps.t: Talk to the Raptor, near the Guardhouse.
Talk to guard captain Sofía or Overseer Siv in the Guardhouse.
Talk to Aster or Bill in the Command Centre.
Talk to Oak or Zoe east of the Command Centre.
Talk to Copperpot, Father Flint or Granny Rowan in the Chapel.
Talk to Princess or Rodney in the Kitchen.
Talk to the Raptor, near the Guardhouse.
Talk to Bill in the Town Hall.
Head east of the Kitchen and collect 4 stone wall segments from the pile of stone.
Fully repair the fortifications with the 4 repair hotspots to the west, north of the broken Workshop.
Talk to Aster, Overseer Siv, or Rodney in the Town Hall. [Chat: 1 Yes, begin the feast.]
Talk to the Raptor, near the Guardhouse.
Enter floor hatch to the east of the Command Centre.
Talk to Zemouregal in his prison cell. [Chat: Any]
